name: Baika
tagline: Ask for a story in any voice and style. Hear it told.
summary: Claude writes it, ElevenLabs performs it, your library keeps it for offline replay.

highlights.label: PERFORM
highlights.title: A story on any topic
highlights.text: Type or dictate. Pick 2, 4 or 7 minutes; Russian, English or Spanish.

highlights.label: STYLES
highlights.title: 8 author styles or your own
highlights.text: Zhvanetsky, Dovlatov, Kharms, bedtime story and more.

highlights.label: VOICES
highlights.title: Six expressive narrators
highlights.text: ElevenLabs voices; narration starts after the first part.

highlights.label: LIBRARY
highlights.title: Stories kept offline
highlights.text: Text and audio stay on the phone. Share as text or .m4a.

highlights.label: PLAYBACK
highlights.title: Plays with the screen off
highlights.text: Lock-screen controls, back and forward 15 seconds.

highlights.label: TALK
highlights.title: Live voice conversation
highlights.text: Built, not yet verified on a device.

steps.title: Pick
steps.text: A topic, a style, a length.
